## Foundation Principle

Every Pull Request should improve at least one of the following:

- Learning Quality
- Decision Quality
- Architectural Quality
- Repository Clarity
- Long-Term Maintainability

The objective is not simply to add features.

The objective is to build a sustainable learning platform.
